questions.instructions: {"task":"What is the customer's predominant emotional state in the most recent part of the call?","guidance":"Weigh the customer's latest turns most heavily; judge the customer, never the employee."}

choices.description: Annoyed or exasperated with the employee, the product, or having to repeat themselves.
Worried about consequences, under time pressure, or uneasy about risk.
Doubting what the employee has told them, or pressing for proof of a claim.
Engaged and working the problem with the employee, without notable distress.
Calm and confident the issue is handled or in good hands.
Matter-of-fact exchange with no clear emotional colour.
